# Kill Chain v3.4.0

Clean install + full Fire Command factory library rebuild.

## Highlights

- **Silent first launch** — Init only, empty sequencer, blank Airspace, boot sound off (no humming preset, no YouTube)
- **220 new factory presets** — 20 curated patches in each of 11 categories, authored for the current synth
- **Old factory banks wiped** — legacy Vol.1/Vol.2 + character-mirror defaults removed from the factory list
- **Session storage bump** — dirty older Fire/Sequencer/Airspace sessions will not reopen mid-stream

## Install

1. Download `Kill-Chain-Setup-3.4.0.exe` below
2. Run the installer
3. Launch **Kill Chain** from the Start menu

Windows may show SmartScreen — choose **More info** → **Run anyway** if you trust this build.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JerryKoller/Kill-Chain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
